scope_quotes: (a) On an individual's person or accessible property—prohibitions. Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property—
scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of an individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
context_quotes: 49 CFR 1540.111 — Carriage of weapons, explosives, and incendiaries by individuals.
alternative_quotes: (1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter;

(3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
choice_text: The prohibition applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
summary: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft.

scope_quotes: (b) On an individual's person or accessible property—permitted carriage of a weapon. Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is one of the following:

(1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport.

(2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter.

(3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all conditions (i) through (iv) are satisfied.
context_quotes: 49 CFR 1540.111 — Carriage of weapons, explosives, and incendiaries by individuals.

choice_text: All of the following conditions must be satisfied: (i) passenger declares to aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking baggage that passenger has an unloaded firearm in the bag; (ii) firearm is unloaded; (iii) firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) container is locked with only the passenger retaining key or combination.
